title: Danba
text: Heading west in Sichuan, there are no trains and only limited public minibuses, so we’re back to travelling by shared taxi. Arriving in Danba, the vibes were high. In the evening, the town square was packed, with three separate dance parties happening simultaneously. Sadly, leaving for Danba was also where Grace and I parted ways with Daniel (as planned) and Thrall (unplanned).
